sources.label: Патчи Morphe для ВКонтакте
sources.author: Patches Vk
patch_list: Bypass security and package checks
Bypasses package verification in AuthBridge and BuildInfo to prevent profile crash and unofficial client warnings, disables dangerous app detection, and disables VPN detection in music.
Clone app
Changes the package name to com.vkontakte.morphe so VK can be installed side-by-side with official VK.
Customize navigation bar
Removes unwanted tabs (Clips, Services, etc.) from the bottom navigation bar.
Disable audio ads
Disables audio ads in the VK music player by routing to the built-in stub ads component.
Disable telemetry

Disables MyTracker analytics. VK's internal AppStartReporter / BaseAnalyticsSender are intentionally left intact because they carry notification-sync/heartbeat traffic (stubbing them made the unread badge stick and delayed message pushes).
Hide clips ads
Removes commercial video ads, market promos, and sponsored content from VK Clips.
Hide feed ads
Hides sponsored posts, promo articles, and recommended mini-apps in newsfeed.
Native anti-tamper bypass
Neutralizes signature and integrity checks in libvkcore.so and libvkmedia.so to prevent crashing on custom-signed APKs.
Unlock background music playback
Removes background playback restrictions, disables screen-off pause, and disables restriction popups.
Unlock offline music downloads

Makes the native download buttons (player icon and the "download" menu action) work without a VK Music subscription, so tracks are saved to VK's offline cache and appear in the "Downloaded" section for offline listening. Also re-enables th…
Video ads
Blocks video player in-stream advertisements (prerolls, midrolls, postrolls, ad overlays), attached promo ad cards below videos, and VK Video / RuStore download prompts.
Video quality preference
Automatically applies the user's preferred video playback quality (1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p) instead of falling back to Auto adaptive bitrate.
